title: A ROOM FULL OF PROJECTS
content: The common room becomes a temporary studio. A half-built model occupies the long table, a laptop plays back a rough edit, and someone is sketching a set of stairs on the back of an envelope. Each person contributes a different skill; by midnight the project has a direction.
